measurement.name: Balearic Current
measurement.range_interpretation: Provider-reported regional width range; no chosen midpoint, confidence interval or whole-current annual extrema. Numeric range is not assigned to seasons.
measurement.geographic_scope: Northern shelf of the Balearic Islands; no specific section gates or paired edge coordinates in the provider summary.
measurement.section_orientation: Not supplied by the regional summary.
measurement.layer: Climatological satellite-imagery surface circulation context; no fixed depth or vertically uniform width layer is specified.
measurement.time_convention: Undated multi-year regional synthesis. Provider version 13 November 2023 and suggested citation year 2021 do not identify width observation dates or the averaging period.
measurement.boundary_rule: Provider-reported width; source does not specify paired edge coordinates or a velocity cutoff. Mean GV 0.2 m/s is not a boundary threshold.
measurement.source_citation: Juza, M. (2021), Regional estimates in the application SOCIB Satellite imagery: western Mediterranean Sea and sub-regions, SOCIB. Reviewed document version 13 November 2023.

measurement.source_quality_note: Provider original reviewed. Exact averaging period, product edition, grid and paired velocity-boundary method remain unspecified. Qualitative autumn maximum is not a numeric seasonal width assignment.

Recover compatible dated and layer-specific sections before annual or monthly physical widths.

original_regional_context.source_access: Relevant original pages read and table visually inspected; not all cited papers or underlying source products reviewed.
original_regional_context.display_aria_label: Balearic Current: provider-reported regional width range 20 to 35 km along the northern island shelf. No midpoint, seasonal endpoint assignment, confidence interval or mapped edges.
original_regional_context.display_caption: SOCIB reports a 20–35 km regional width range along the northern Balearic shelf. Representative width and numeric uncertainty remain unknown; no midpoint selected.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Provider table, version 13 November 2023. Mean GV 0.2 m/s is not an edge cutoff. Autumn maximum is qualitative variability, not a 35 km autumn width. Sampling period, paired boundaries and exact width method are unspecified; whole-current and annual ranges remain unknown.

previous_source_review_record.reason: Reviewed source gives a qualitative broader/shallower comparison only. A separate 10-20 km event upwelling band is a thermal-water feature, not an admitted Balearic current width. No numerical current width or seasonal span extracted.
